主要内容: On March 10, 2017, DISH Network Corporation announced its intention to issue and sell $1 billion aggregate principal amount of convertible notes. The convertible notes will be offered and sold to institutional accredited investors who are also qualified institutional buyers on a private placement basis. The net proceeds from the placement are intended to be used for strategic transactions, which may include wireless and spectrum-related transactions, and for other general corporate purposes. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and incorporated by reference.
